calls.name: on
calls.doc: Registers the handler of one of the manifest's commands: choosing the command in the palette calls it. A second call for the same command replaces the handler.

arguments.name: id
arguments.doc: The command's id, as the manifest's `commands` declares it.

arguments.name: handler
arguments.doc: Called with no argument when the command is chosen. It may return a promise.

calls.name: show
calls.doc: Shows a message to the person: a toast of the window, or the system's notification when the program says its messages there.

calls.name: register
calls.doc: Registers the render of one of the manifest's views. A second call for the same view replaces it.

arguments.name: id
arguments.doc: The view's id, as the manifest's `views` declares it.

calls.name: update
calls.doc: Asks for the view's render again, after the current handler: the plugin's state changed outside a handler of the view (a command, a promise that settled).

calls.name: get
calls.doc: The value of one of the manifest's settings: the person's, else its default. A boolean, a number or a string, as the setting's kind says.

arguments.name: id
arguments.doc: The setting's id, as the manifest's `settings` declares it.

calls.name: onChange
calls.doc: Registers a function called after each change of one of the plugin's settings, in the settings or their file. The views are rendered again after it.

arguments.name: handler
arguments.type: (id: string, value: string | number | boolean) => void | Promise<void>

calls.name: write
calls.doc: Writes a text file, its folders made when they are missing.

calls.name: pick
calls.doc: Asks the person for a file or a folder in the system's dialog, while they act in the plugin. What they pick is granted until they revoke it in the Plugins page; null: they picked nothing.

calls.name: fetch
calls.doc: Asks an address of an origin the manifest names (or any public one with "net:*"). Each redirect is checked as the first address was: a hop to an origin not granted fails the call.

calls.name: read
calls.doc: Reads the clipboard's text, while the person acts in the plugin (a command, a click in its view).

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Its look ("info" when absent).

fields.name: title
fields.doc: A line in bold above the text.

types.name: Activate_Context
types.doc: What the entry file's activate(context) is given (gt:plugins makes it: plugins/runtime.odin, context_object).

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The plugin's id, as plugin.json says it.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Its name.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: Its version ("" when plugin.json says none).

fields.name: api
fields.doc: The level of the API this program gives.

types.name: Button_Look
types.doc: How a button sits: `raised` has a face of its own; `ghost` none until the pointer is over it (an act repeated in each row of a list); `link` reads as a link.

types.name: Button_Size
types.doc: A button's size, all its measures together; `small` for an act in each row of a list, `large` for the one act of a view.

types.name: Space_Size
types.doc: A step of the toolkit's spacing scale; `fill` takes the room left in a row.

types.name: Files_Pick_Options
types.doc: What the system's dialog of files.pick offers.

fields.name: folder
fields.doc: A folder, not a file.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: The dialog's title.

fields.name: method
fields.doc: "GET" when absent.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: The request's body, as text.

fields.name: contentType
fields.doc: Its Content-Type.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Its HTTP status.

fields.name: url
fields.doc: The address that answered, after the redirects.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: Its body, as text.

nodes.name: text
nodes.doc: A paragraph of text; it wraps in a column.

fields.name: weak
fields.doc: Drawn in the weak colour.

nodes.name: heading
nodes.doc: A title of a part of the view.

fields.name: look
fields.doc: How it sits and its size. A program older than these fields shows a raised, medium button.

fields.name: onClick
fields.doc: Called when it is pressed.

nodes.name: column
nodes.doc: Its children one under the other.

nodes.name: card
nodes.doc: A titled panel around its children, as wide as the view.

nodes.name: space
nodes.doc: Room between two nodes ("small" when absent).

nodes.name: field
nodes.doc: A line of text the person types. The host keeps what is typed: a value the plugin gives is shown unless the person typed since the plugin last heard of it. Without a value, the field keeps its own text.

fields.name: onChange
fields.doc: Called with the text at each change.

fields.name: onSubmit
fields.doc: Called with the text when Enter is pressed.

nodes.name: check
nodes.doc: A check box and its words.

fields.name: onChange
fields.doc: Called with its new state when the person changes it.

fields.name: onChange
fields.doc: Called with its new state when the person changes it.

nodes.name: list
nodes.doc: A list of `count` rows that the program asks for by range, only those in view and a margin: a list of a million rows costs what its screen shows. A row not answered yet shows a placeholder. Change `version` when the rows' content changes: the rows kept are dropped and asked again (an answer for an older version is dropped).

fields.name: count
fields.doc: How many rows it has (1 000 000 at most).

fields.name: version
fields.doc: Its rows' content: rows kept for another version are dropped.

fields.name: rowHeight
fields.doc: A row's height in lines of text, before its rows are measured (2 when absent).

fields.name: visibleRows
fields.doc: How many rows high the list is (10 when absent).

fields.name: row
fields.doc: Each row's node.
